summary: This directory provides a bridge between the application's form submission logic and the Shadcn UI library. It houses reusable form-specific UI components designed to handle state transitions, such as loading indicators, while maintaining consistency with the Shadcn design system.
responsibilities: Bridge generic form functionality with Shadcn UI components
Manage visual feedback for form submission states
Encapsulate consistent styling and behavior for form buttons
relationships: The UI adapters translate application-level form requirements into Shadcn-compatible component structures.
The loading state concept is integrated into the submission button to provide user feedback during asynchronous operations.
designDecisions: Implementation follows an adapter pattern to decouple core form logic from specific UI framework components.
Centralizes UI overrides and enhancements for standard Shadcn components.
